title: Light and Fresh Kenyan Soup
description: A light and refreshing soup inspired by the flavors of Kenya. This vegetarian soup is perfect for a light meal or snack.
instructions: Heat the soup in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the bass, sea salt, and thyme to the pot.
Pour in the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
Simmer for 10 more minutes to allow flavors to meld together.
Strain the soup to remove the bass and thyme.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
